Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You search the sheltered cracks where the mountain keeps its small stores of life.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
One hour per attempt.
Target / range / shape
Viable mountain terrain; one hour
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Spend one hour searching a place that contains usable resources. Choose food or ordinary mineral or plant materials, then roll Knowledge. Improve one matching supply bundle; if you have none, its first step creates a d4 supply. Further steps raise it to d6, then d8. This card cannot raise a bundle above d8.

Weak
Raise the bundle by 1 inventory step.
Standard
Raise it by 2 inventory steps.
Strong
Raise it by 3 inventory steps.

The DA determines what resources are present. You cannot produce rare treasure or harvest a patch that has already been exhausted.
